Private base URI string returned by _baseURI and used in tokenURI.
Ownable owner address; gates all onlyOwner administrative and withdrawal functions.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient and the subject of the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) guard in mintToken.
tx.origin is compared against msg.sender, providing a weak and spoofable anti-contract access condition.
block.timestamp feeds directly into getRandomNumber, creating timestamp-dependent randomness.
msg.sender is hashed into the merkle leaf inside verify, tying whitelist eligibility to caller identity.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on msg.sender if it is a contract, giving the caller an external hook.
The onERC721Received callback executes before the mint loop completes, allowing re-entry into mintToken.
The caller-supplied proof array is forwarded to MerkleProof.verify.
The computed leaf hash is the value compared against the merkle root in verify.
The stored merkle root is read by verify to validate the whitelist proof.
amount is validated (0 < amount <= 33) and multiplied by the unit price and added to totalSupply.
The computed price is multiplied by amount to enforce msg.value >= price * amount.
WHITELIST_PRICE is selected as the unit price when the pre-sale proof verifies.
PRICE is selected as the unit price for public mints.
MAX_TOKENS bounds the arithmetic expression totalSupply() + amount.
The loop counter governs repeated quantity arithmetic and _safeMint calls.
mintToken conditionally calls verify(proof) when preSaleIsActive is true.
mintToken loops and calls the internal _safeMint for each token.
saleIsActive is a required branch condition in mintToken.
preSaleIsActive gates both the verification requirement and the price selection.
pickWinner calls getRandomNumber() to derive numWinner.
totalChance is the modulo divisor for the winner draw and can revert if zero.
chances is indexed and summed in the loop until currNum reaches numWinner.
numWinner drives the while-loop termination condition.
currNum is accumulated with chances entries.
index is incremented and returned as index - 1.
newPrice is written into the PRICE state variable.
newMaxTokens is written into the MAX_TOKENS state variable.
winner is used as the payable recipient in transferReward.
amount is passed to the ETH transfer in transferReward.
_root is written into the root state variable.
baseURI is stored via _setBaseURI.
tokenId is checked for existence and forwarded to super.tokenURI.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setPrice to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setMaxTokens to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts flipSaleState to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts flipPreSaleState to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts withdraw10 to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts withdrawTotal to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts transferReward to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setRoot to _owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setBaseURI to _owner.
withdraw10 executes the ETH transfer operation to owner().
withdrawTotal executes the ETH transfer of the full balance to owner().
transferReward executes the ETH transfer to the winner address.
verify delegates hashing to MerkleProof._efficientHash which uses inline assembly.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a mint parameter consumed only by mintToken arithmetic and supply checks.
proof is consumed only as the merkle proof argument of verify().
price is a transient local used solely to compute the mint cost inside mintToken.
i is the local loop counter controlling the _safeMint loop in mintToken.
leaf is a local hash computed and consumed only inside verify().
newPrice is the sole input parameter of setPrice.
newMaxTokens is the sole input parameter of setMaxTokens.
winner is the sole recipient parameter of transferReward.
amount is the value parameter of transferReward.
_root is the sole input parameter of setRoot.
baseURI is the sole input parameter of setBaseURI.
tokenId is the sole input parameter of tokenURI.
chances is the weighted array parameter of pickWinner.
totalChance is the divisor parameter of pickWinner.
numWinner is a local random target used only inside pickWinner.
currNum is a local accumulator used only inside pickWinner.
index is a local loop cursor returned by pickWinner.
